verdict.rationale: The only documented entry requirement for the core online filing flow is a credential account: patent filing states "You'll need your One Login details if you have them, or you can set them up." The trade mark page says applications can be sent online or by post but documents no keyless or file-number entry path. Search by trade mark number is a lookup feature, not a way to start filing, and the paper or email fallback is not an online flow.
